text: Conditions d’admission 1. Étudiants autonomes : candidats âgés entre 18 et 35 (jusqu’au 31 inclus en décembre de l’année de candidature) ; citoyens non chinois ayant obtenu un diplôme du secondaire ou supérieur et en bonne santé ; 2. Les candidats who are immigrants from the Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macao,and Taiwan (China) and are a foreign national, or whose parents are both Chinese citizens and have settled abroad,or whohavebeen a foreign nationalsince birthmust meet the requirements of the Ministry of Education's Jiao Wai Han [2020] No.12; 3. Applicants under the age of 18 (before August 31 in the current year). 4. Proof of language proficiency: IELTS test certificate with total score no less than 6.5 or TOFEL IBT certificate with total score no less than 85 or GRE certificate with total score no less than 310. International students from English speaking countries or graduated from international high schools teaching in English do not need to provide English language certificate when submitting the admission application.The Original certification version should be provided when making registration. International students from English speaking countries or graduated from international high schools teaching in English do not need to provide English language certificate when submitting the admission application. If the English proficiency test certificate cannot be provided on time due to the epidemic, please submit a personal statement on your English proficiency first. The college will notify the alternative assessment methods and contents in accordance with specific conditions. 5. For students applying for the Civil Engineering program, the CSCA exam subjects are Mathematics and Physics(the test papers are in English).
